THE HARD CASE. Immediately upstream of trbK in the same trb operon. Lessl and Lyras report low-level entry exclusion activity for IncP-alpha TrbJ; Haase's data conflict, for reasons not established. UniProt names it gene 'eexA' / 'Entry exclusion protein A' (Q79AS0), which collides with R27 eexA. More informative than a random negative: same operon, adjacent to the real exclusion gene, partial evidence, unresolved literature. Any scan that cannot separate trbJ from trbK has not solved the problem.
